result: If I could change the world in one way, I would strive to eliminate global poverty. This change would have a profound impact on numerous other issues, including education, healthcare, and social equality. By ensuring that everyone has access to basic needs such as food, shelter, and education, we could create a more just and equitable world where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. This would also help address environmental degradation, as sustainable practices often go hand in hand with economic stability and education.
